title: Parallel Non-Integer Multiple-Cell-Height Node Remapping
extraction_scope: NTU thesis repository metadata and English abstract; no thesis PDF extraction and no conference-paper full text.

identity.limit: The repository identifies a thesis with the same English title and author team, but it does not establish that every thesis experiment or number appears in the ICCAD paper.

mechanism: Parallel longest-path-first and iterative minimum-slack-first remapping prioritize timing-critical nodes and reduce exhaustive mapping overhead for non-integer multiple-cell-height standard-cell designs.
reported_claim: The thesis abstract reports an average 8.92x runtime speedup versus a state-of-the-art approach while preserving placement quality; the existing conference-linked institutional abstract assessment records a separate 5.58x claim.
conditions: The thesis abstract names timing-aware remapping, non-integer multiple-cell-height standard cells, and placement-quality preservation, but does not specify benchmark circuits, machine, thread count, baseline identity, or quality tolerance.

discrepancy.resolution: unresolved; do not combine, average, or promote either number to the conference paper

limits: Related thesis abstract is not the ICCAD manuscript and supplies no tables or reproducible setup.
Placement-quality preservation is qualitative without tolerance or metric definition.
No full-paper extraction or independent review/replication.
next_action: Recover the ICCAD manuscript or a source-bound table and reconcile the 5.58x versus 8.92x claims before coding any headline metric.
